_note: Approvals for the automatic import after a deploy (what a person would tick on the Import screen). Every warning class needs a reason; every large change needs its record ID in large; missing records need a decision in missing (ID: removed_from_game, draft or ignore).

warnings.community_required: Seed data from the community Fandom wiki fisch.fandom.com (CC BY-SA), owner decision 2026-11-23 (Fisch plan approved, no in-game checks asked of Ali). Values show 'Source: community wiki'. Where the wiki's own numbers disagree (C$ per kg x average weight vs its average value), the value is left empty instead of picked.
warnings.meta_missing: The wiki gives no reliable update schedule, so the hub leaves it out.
warnings.meta_provenance: calc_defaults is our own editorial choice, not a game fact.
warnings.outlier: Event, admin-event and limited fish sit far from regular fish of the same rarity; values match the wiki fish infoboxes.
warnings.rarity_order: Fisch rarity does not track value or weight closely (event, limited and special fish); values match the wiki fish infoboxes.
